description: Cloud communications platform providing APIs for messaging, voice, video, verification, and network features.
auth_notes: Vonage APIs use API keys and secrets (sent as basic auth or header parameters) and JSON Web Tokens (JWT) for secure application access.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free developer account on the Vonage dashboard self-serve, which typically includes trial credits.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST and websocket APIs covering SMS, RCS, WhatsApp, Voice, Video, Verify, and Account management.
mcp_notes: No official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server published by Vonage as of current documentation.
rationale: Vonage provides fully documented public APIs and self-serve free developer accounts, making it immediately buildable into an AI agent toolkit.

evidence.note: Details supported authentication methods including API key/secret, basic auth, and JWT.
Developer portal allows users to sign up for a free developer account.
Lists the comprehensive API surface including messaging, voice, video, and verify APIs.
Official Vonage GitHub organization does not list any MCP server repositories.
